channel.title: Citizen News & Media Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Citizen News & Media Limited (hackneycitizen.co.uk)

item.title: ‘Groundbreaking’ community alliance launches to ‘campaign for political alternative’ in Hackney
item.description: Hackney Independent Socialist Collective, one of the UK’s newest political parties, has joined forces with four other local organisations and will launch their collaboration later this week

item.title: London housebuilding starts to plummet despite housing crisis
item.description: Housebuilding starts in the capital have fallen by 84 per cent since 2015

item.title: Obituary: Peter Howden, luminary of independent cinema, dies aged 80
item.description: Howden was a fixture of the London film scene, spending the latter half of his six-decade career at the Rio in Dalston

item.title: LTNs and bus lanes increase congestion in parts of London, TfL bosses admit
item.description: TfL aims to ensure 80 per cent of journeys made in London are by walking, cycling or public transport by 2041.

item.title: Housing loophole puts domestic abuse victims at risk even if they leave home, council warns
item.description: Hackney is one of many councils pushing for regulations that would allow it to evict domestic abusers

item.title: Hackney residents stand up to council over ‘unlawful’ plans for Marian Court
item.description: Redevelopment of the site had stalled amid changes to safety regulations and financial woes, but plans were revived in late November last year

item.title: London falls below ‘acceptable level’ of breast cancer screening uptake thanks to ‘population churn’
item.description: Breast cancer screening coverage in the capital has continued to lag behind other regions of the UK

item.title: Record number of fires linked to e-bikes and e-scooters as pressure mounts to regulate vehicles
item.description: Two Londoners lost their lives to the fires in 2025

item.title: Zoë Garbett urges Sadiq Khan to act on housing crisis as it ‘hits families and disabled Londoners hardest’
item.description: Garbett, Chair of the London Assembly Housing Committee, said vulnerable Londoners and families were being the worst affected by the capital's housing crisis

item.title: Campaigners urge Hackney NHS Trust to to reject ‘shocking’ data sharing program
item.description: Campaigners gathered outside the town hall last week to urge Homerton Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust to reject a new information-sharing system currently being rolled out nationwide
